seoTitle: Seminole County School Calendar 2026-2027 | Holidays, Breaks, PDF & ICS
seoDescription: Seminole County Public Schools calendar 2026-2027 with first day, last day, holidays, breaks, PDF, ICS, and family planning notes.
heroSummary: This guide explains the Seminole County Public Schools 2026-2027 calendar, including the August 10 first student day, May 25 last student day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, Jan. 4-5 student holidays, the March 22 teacher workday, official PDF access, ICS import, and the SCPS inclement-weather make-up day order.
calendarNotes: Seminole County Public Schools starts the 2026-2027 school year on August 10, 2026 and lists May 25, 2027 as the end of the fourth quarter and last student day. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23-27, Winter Break runs December 21-January 3, and Spring Break runs March 15-19. Teacher workdays and student holidays on October 12, January 4, January 5, and March 22 are important planning dates because they sit near quarter transitions or major breaks. The official PDF lists inclement-weather make-up days in this order: January 5, January 4, October 12, March 22, and May 27.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Seminole County start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Seminole County Public Schools starts the 2026-2027 school year on Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Seminole County in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The SCPS 2026-2027 student attendance calendar lists Tuesday, May 25, 2027 as the end of Quarter 4 and the last student day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Seminole County Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Sunday, January 3, 2027. January 4 is a teacher workday/student holiday and January 5 is a district PD day/student holiday, so families should verify the student return date with SCPS announcements.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Seminole County Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Why do January 4 and January 5 matter in the SCPS 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: January 4, 2027 is listed as a teacher workday/student holiday, and January 5, 2027 is listed as a district professional development day/student holiday. Winter Break ends January 3, but students do not begin Quarter 3 until Wednesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after Spring Break in Seminole County?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ends Friday, March 19, 2027. March 22 is a teacher workday, so the official calendar lists the beginning of Quarter 4 on Tuesday, March 23, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the SCPS 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The quarter day counts are 44, 44, 46, and 46 days, for a total of 180 student days.

calendarFaqs.q: Which SCPS 2026-2027 dates are listed as inclement-weather make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists make-up days in this order: January 5, 2027; January 4, 2027; October 12, 2026; March 22, 2027; and May 27, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Can I add the Seminole County school calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. MySchoolDates provides a one-time ICS file generated from reviewed SCPS calendar records. It can be imported into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook, but it will not automatically update if SCPS revises the official calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the SCPS calendar include bell schedules?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The SCPS student attendance calendar shows districtwide school-year dates. Bell schedules, open house times, testing schedules, athletics, and graduation details are handled by individual schools.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families verify Seminole County calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official Seminole County Public Schools calendar page and school-level announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with SCPS.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Seminole County have school on Labor Day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The SCPS 2026-2027 student attendance calendar lists Labor Day, Monday, September 7, 2026, as a holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: What day do students return after Winter Break in Seminole County?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ends Sunday, January 3, 2027, but January 4 is a teacher workday/student holiday and January 5 is a district professional development day/student holiday. The calendar lists the beginning of Quarter 3 on Wednesday, January 6, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Are SCPS teacher workdays no-school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: Several Seminole County teacher workdays and district professional development days are student holidays, including October 12, January 4, January 5, and March 22 in the 2026-2027 calendar. Families should still verify campus-specific schedules with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the Seminole County school calendar include early release days?
calendarFaqs.a: The reviewed 2026-2027 SCPS student attendance calendar focuses on districtwide attendance dates, holidays, teacher workdays, professional development days, and make-up days. Early release times and bell schedule details should be confirmed through Seminole County Public Schools and individual schools.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Seminole County have school on Presidents Day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The SCPS 2026-2027 student attendance calendar lists Presidents Day, Monday, February 15, 2027, as a holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the SCPS calendar traditional or year-round?
calendarFaqs.a: The reviewed 2026-2027 Seminole County Public Schools student attendance calendar follows a traditional academic calendar. Specialized programs, school-level events, and bell schedules should still be verified with SCPS or the assigned school.

whatsNew.title: Changes from the 2025-2026 SCPS Calendar
content: The first student day moves from August 11 in 2025 to August 10 in 2026.
The last student day moves from May 27 in 2026 to May 25 in 2027.
Spring Break moves from March 16-20 in 2026 to March 15-19 in 2027.
The 2026-2027 calendar lists five inclement-weather make-up dates, including a post-planning date on May 27, 2027.

customSections.label: SCPS Calendar Summary for Families
customSections.content: SCPS follows a traditional August-to-May school calendar for 2026-2027, but families should pay special attention to extended no-student windows around Winter Break, Spring Break, and the district's published inclement-weather make-up day sequence. The headline dates answer when school starts and ends; the planning value comes from knowing which teacher workdays and student holidays sit next to major breaks.

customSections.label: About the SCPS 2026-2027 Calendar
customSections.content: Seminole County Public Schools follows a traditional academic calendar for the 2026-2027 school year. The district calendar includes 180 instructional days across four quarters, with major no-school periods for Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, and Spring Break. It also lists teacher workdays, district professional development days, post-planning dates, and a conditional make-up day order for weather-related closures.

groups.label: Spring Break buffer
items: March 22 is a teacher workday, which gives families a longer no-student planning window before Quarter 4 begins on March 23.

groups.label: Weather make-up sequence
items: The official calendar lists make-up days in order rather than leaving families to infer which dates may be used.
The published sequence is January 5, January 4, October 12, March 22, and May 27.
